name: Convection
description: When Convection destroys a living enemy model, you can give 1 focus point to a warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range.

name: Energizer
description: Each model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is currently in its control range can immediately advance up to 2". Energizer can be cast only once per activation.

name: Hellwrought
description: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 ARM and Retaliation. (If a model with Retaliation was damaged by an enemy attack during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase it can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.)

name: Quagmire
description: While B2B with target friendly Faction model/unit, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and cannot advance.

name: Batten Down the Hatches
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup cannot become knocked down and gain +3 ARM but suffer –2 DEF. Batten Down the Hatches lasts for one round.

name: Torment
description: When a model is damaged by Torment, for one round it loses Tough, cannot remove damage, and cannot transfer damage.

name: Recoil
description: The spellcaster gains Swift Hunter. Recoil lasts for one turn. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

name: Bombshell
description: On a critical hit, models hit are thrown d6" directly away from the attacker. Roll distance once for all models affected. Move models farthest from the attacker first. Instead of suffering blast damage, models hit but not directly hit suffer a POW 10 damage roll. The POW of collateral damage is 10.

name: Mobility
description: Models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range gain +2 SPD and Pathfinder for one turn.

name: Revive
description: Target one friendly trooper model. Return one destroyed Grunt model to the target model’s unit. The Grunt is returned with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target model. The Grunt model must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is returned to play.

name: Vision
description: When target friendly Faction model is directly hit by an attack, you can choose to have it suffer no damage roll from the attack, then Vision expires.

name: Dark Seduction
description: Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model. You can immediately make a full advance with that enemy model followed by a basic attack, then Dark Seduction expires. Dark Seduction can be cast only once per activation. A model can be affected by Dark Seduction only once per turn.

name: Hand of Morrow
description: Target friendly Faction model’s/unit’s weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical.

name: Flashing Blade
description: The spellcaster immediately makes one basic attack with one of its melee weapons against each enemy model in its LOS that is in the weapon’s melee range. These attacks are simultaneous.

name: Ward
description: Enemy spells that target an affected friendly model suffer and -5 RNG and +1 COST. When an affected model it directly hit bay an enemy arcane attack, Ward expires.

name: Crusader's Call
description: Friendly Faction models beginning a charge in the spellcaster’s control range gain +2 SPD. Crusader’s Call lasts for one turn.

name: Fortune
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit can reroll its missed attack rolls. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Fortune.

name: Repudiate
description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit directly hit by Repudiate immediately expire. When an upkeep spell expires as a result of Repudiate, the model maintaining the spell suffers d3 damage points.

name: Sunburst
description: Sunburst blast damage affects only enemy models. Models boxed by Sunburst are removed from play.

name: Arcantrik Bolt
description: A warjack damaged by this attack becomes stationary for one round.

name: Blur
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +3 DEF against ranged and arcane attacks.

name: Death Ward
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM. If an affected warjack is damaged, choose which column suffers the damage.

name: Iron Aggression
description: Target friendly Faction warjack can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus and gains boosted melee attack rolls.

name: Scourge
description: On a direct hit, models hit by this attack become knocked down.

name: Snipe
description: Target friendly Faction model’s/unit’s ranged weapons gain +3 RNG.

name: Bullet Dodger
description: Target friendly Faction model gains +2 DEF and Dodge. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

name: Calamity
description: Target enemy model/unit suffers –2 DEF and ARM.

name: Escort
description: Cohort models in the spellcaster's battlegroup beginning their activations in the spellcaster's control range gain +2 SPD when advancing as part of their Normal Movement. The spellcaster gains +2 ARM while one or more cohort models in its battlegroup are within 3" of it.

name: Obliteration
description: On a critical hit, models hit are knocked down.

name: Flicker
description: Place models in Caine’s battlegroup currently in his control range  anywhere completely within 2" of their current locations. Flicker can be cast only once per activation.

name: Mage Sight
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Eyeless Sight.

name: Fire Group
description: While models in the spellcaster's battlegroup are in its control range, their ranged weapons gain +2 RNG. Fire Group lasts for one turn.

name: Moving Shadows
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Run & Gun. (At the end of its activation, if it destroyed one or more enemy models with ranged attacks that activation, a model with Run & Gun can make a full advance.)

name: Psycho Surgery
description: Each model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range can immediately remove d3 + 1 damage points. This spell can be cast only once per activation.

name: Deadweight
description: When Deadweight destroys an enemy living or undead model, choose an enemy model within 2" of it. The chosen model must forfeit either its Normal Movement or its Combat Action during its next activation, as its controller chooses.

name: Psychic Assault
description: This spell ignores LOS.

name: Scything Touch
description: Target friendly Faction model gains Dark Shroud. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer – 2 ARM.)

name: Occult Whispers
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on their Arcane Attack rolls. Occult Whispers lasts for one turn.

name: Avenging Force
description: If one or more friendly Faction warrior models were damaged by enemy attacks while in the spellcaster's control range during your opponent’s last turn, during your Maintenance Phase one model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup in its control range can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

name: Burning Ash
description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. While in the template, living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls.

name: Fortify
description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 ARM. That model and any friendly models B2B with it cannot become knocked down, be pushed, or be moved by a slam.

name: Return Fire
description: When target friendly Faction model is targeted by an enemy ranged attack, after the attack is resolved the affected model can make one basic melee or ranged attack, then Return Fire expires. Return Fire lasts for one round.

name: Bleed
description: When Bleed damages a living enemy model, this model can remove d3 damage points.

name: Blood Rain
description: Blood Rain causes corrosion damage. Models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

name: Playing God
description: Target friendly living Faction warbeast is affected by Spontaneous Mutation effects while they affect Absylonia. Additionally, once per turn Absylonia can transfer damage to the affected warbeast without spending fury.

name: Refuge
description: At the end of an activation in which target friendly Faction model hit an enemy model with an attack, the affected model can make a full advance.

name: Wild Aggression
description: Target friendly living warbeast in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without being forced and gains boosted melee attack rolls.

name: Indomitable
description: The spellcaster gains Unyielding. Indomitable lasts for one round. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

name: Counterblast
description: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 5" of the spellcaster, the spellcaster can make one basic melee or ranged attack targeting that model, then Counterblast expires. Counterblast lasts for one round.

name: Force Blast
description: Target a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. Enemy models currently within 2" of the target model are pushed 2" directly away from it in the order you choose.

name: Force Hammer
description: Instead of suffering a normal damage roll, a non-incorporeal model Force Hammer hits is slammed d6" directly away from the spell’s point of origin and suffers a POW 12 damage roll. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 12.

name: Polarity Shield
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Polarity Field. (A model with Polarity Field cannot be targeted by a charge or slam power attack made by a construct model.)

name: Telekinesis
description: Place target friendly model completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed by Telekinesis only once per turn.

name: Storm Rager
description: Target friendly Faction warrior model gains +2 MAT and ARM and +2 on melee attack damage rolls and cannot be targeted by combined ranged attacks or combined melee attacks.

name: Onslaught
description: The spellcaster and friendly Faction models beginning their activations in its control range gain Relentless Charge for one turn. (While advancing as part of a charge, a model with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

name: Perdition
description: When an enemy model is damaged by Perdition, immediately after the attack is resolved the spellcaster or one model in its battlegroup that is currently in its control range can advance up to 5" directly toward the nearest enemy model. A model can advance as a result of Perdition only once per turn.

name: Rough Seas
description: When a friendly model in the spellcaster’s control range is targeted with a ranged attack, the attacking model rolls an additional die on its attack roll. Discard the highest die of each roll. Rough Seas lasts for one round.

name: Attractor
description: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster are immediately pushed 2" directly toward it in the order you choose.

name: Censure
description: Enemy upkeep spells in the spellcaster’s control range immediately expire. A model can keep any of its upkeep spells in play by suffering d3 damage points per spell. Roll a separate d3 for each spell. This damage cannot be transferred or reduced by spending focus points. Remove one damage point from the spellcaster for each damage point caused by Censure. Censure can be cast only one per activation.

name: Curse of Shadows
description: Target model/unit suffers –2 ARM. A model can advance through an affected model if it has enough movement to move completely past its base.

name: Hellmouth
description: On a direct hit, before making the damage roll, push models within 2" of the model directly hit 2" directly toward it in the order you choose. Models boxed by Hellmouth are removed from play.

name: Teleport
description: Place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 6" of its current location, then its activation ends.

name: Tether
description: Immediately after the spellcaster ends its Normal Movement, target cohort in its battlegroup can advance up to 3" directly toward it.

name: Hellfire
description: Models disabled by Hellfire cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by Hellfire are removed from play.

name: Occultation
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Stealth.

name: Repulsion
description: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster are immediately pushed 3" directly away from it in the order you choose.

name: Deathbringers
description: While within the spellcaster’s control range, the melee weapons of models in its battlegroup gain Grievous Wounds. Deathbringers lasts for one turn. (A model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

name: Caustic Mist
description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model entering or ending its activation in the template suffers the Corrosion continuous effect.

name: Bond of Gristle & Bone
description: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +2 ARM and Feign Death. (A model with Feign Death cannot be targeted by ranged or magic attacks while knocked down.)

name: Carnage
description: Friendly Faction models gain +2 to melee attack rolls against enemy models in the spellcaster’s control range. Carnage lasts for one turn.

name: Fury’s Strength
description: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one turn.

name: Gallows
description: When an enemy model is hit by this attack, it can be pushed d6" directly toward Gallows’ point of origin.

name: Hex Blast
description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit directly hit by Hex Blast immediately expire.

name: Disintegration
description: The model hit suffers –2 ARM for one round. A model boxed by Disintegration is removed from play.

name: Impending Doom
description: Enemy models within 5" of the spellcaster are pushed 5" directly toward it in the order you choose.

name: Affliction
description: Target model/unit suffers –2 DEF. When a damage roll resulting from a direct hit fails to exceed the ARM of an affected model, the model suffers 1 damage point.

name: Well of Secrets
description: Enemy upkeep spells on the spellcaster immediately expire. Additionally, the spellcaster gains Sacred Ward for one round. (A model with Sacred Ward cannot be targeted by enemy spells.)

name: Lightning Strike
description: The spellcaster gains Sprint. Lightning Strike lasts for one turn. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

name: Boundless Charge
description: During its activation, target friendly Faction model can charge without spending focus or being forced and gains +2 SPD and Pathfinder when it charges. Boundless Charge lasts for one turn.

name: Bulwark
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range and B2B with one or more models in its battlegroup, models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gain +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down.

name: Cleansing Fire
description: Cleansing Fire causes fire damage. On a critical hit, models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.

name: Deceleration
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM against ranged and arcane attack damage rolls. Deceleration lasts for one round.

name: Hallowed Avenger
description: Target friendly Faction Cohort model gains Righteous Vengeance. (If one or more friendly Faction warrior models were destroyed or removed from play by enemy attacks while within 5" of a model with Righteous Vengeance during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase the model with Righteous Vengeance can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.)

name: Scuttler
description: The spellcaster gains Dig In. (A model with Dig In gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.)

name: Acidic Touch
description: The spellcaster gains Resistance: Corrosion and its melee weapons gain the Continuous Effect: Corrosion. Acidic Touch lasts for one round.

name: Swarm
description: The spellcaster gains concealment. Living enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of the spellcaster. Swarm lasts for one round.

name: Draconic Aura
description: When an enemy model suffers a fire damage roll while within 10" of the spellcaster, add +2 to the roll. Fire continuous effects affecting enemy models within 10" of the spellcaster cannot expire. Draconic Aura lasts for one round.

name: Jackhammer
description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range immediately makes one basic melee attack.

name: The Lash
description: When The Lash damages an enemy model, immediately after the attack is resolved this model or a friendly Faction model within 3" of it can advance up to 2". A model can advance only once per turn as a result of The Lash.

name: Quicken
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 SPD and DEF against ranged and magic attack rolls.

name: Arcane Propulsion
description: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 SPD, +2 DEF, and Flight.

name: Bladed Gale
description: Models hit lose Flight for one round.

name: Hand of Destruction
description: Friendly models in this model’s battlegroup gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls against target model/unit. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

name: Spirit Door
description: Choose a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. Immediately place that model completely within 2" of the spellcaster. If the chosen model is the spellcaster, immediately place it completely within 2" of another model in its battlegroup that was in its control range at the time the spell was cast. A model cannot advance or attack after being placed by Spirit Door this turn.

name: Admonition
description: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 6" of target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup, the affected model can immediately advance up to 3", then Admonition expires.

name: Hunting Howls
description: Enemy models lose Stealth while within 5" of the spellcaster. Hunting Howls lasts for one turn.

name: Chain Lightning
description: A model hit by Chain Lightning suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll, and lightning arcs from that model to d3 consecutive additional models. The lightning arcs to the nearest model it has not already arced to within 3" of the last model it arced to, ignoring this model. Each model the lightning arcs to suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Resolve lightning arc damage rolls simultaneously with the damage from the attack that caused the leap.

name: Electrify
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls, Resistance: Electricity, and Repulsor Field. (When a model model with Repulsor Field is hit with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved the attacking model is pushed 1" directly away from that model.)

name: Force Field
description: The spellcaster cannot become knocked down. While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast and do not suffer collateral damage.

name: Fail-Safe
description: Target friendly Faction warjack gains +2 ARM and does not suffer the effects of crippled systems.

name: Locomotion
description: The spellcaster spends up to 3 focus points to cast Locomotion. Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup immediately advances up to 1" for each focus point spent. A Cohort model can be targeted by Locomotion only once per activation.

name: Watcher
description: Once per turn when an enemy model advances and ends its movement within 6" of the spellcaster, you can choose a Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. That Cohort model can immediately make a full advance toward the enemy model and then can make one basic attack targeting the enemy model.

name: Artifice of Deviation
description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. While in the template, friendly Faction models gain cover. Enemy models treat the template as rough terrain.

name: Blood of Liberty
description: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Llaelese models gain Tough and +2 ARM.

name: Chosen Ground
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Pathfinder and cannot become knocked down.

name: Distraction
description: Target warrior model/unit cannot make ranged attacks and suffers –2 DEF and MAT for one round.

name: Cloak of Ash
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Ashen Veil. (A model with Ashen Veil has concealment. Living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of a model with Ashen Veil.)

name: Inviolable Resolve
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down or moved by a push or a slam.

name: Last Stand
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains an additional die on its melee attack and melee damage rolls. If an affected model makes a melee attack, it is destroyed at the end of the turn.

name: Lock the Target
description: A model damaged by Lock the Target cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.

name: Aerogenesis
description: The spellcaster and friendly Faction warrior models/units beginning their activations in its control range gain +2 SPD and Flight during their activations. Aerogenesis lasts for one turn.

name: Arcane Might
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction non-Leader warrior models can spend 1 focus or fury point on the spellcaster to boost a melee attack or melee damage roll during their activations.

name: Ignite
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to melee attack damage rolls. Affected models gain Critical Fire on their melee attacks.

name: Purification
description: Continuous effects, animi, and upkeep spells in the spellcaster’s control range immediately expire.

name: Stygian Abyss
description: On a critical hit, the model hit suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

name: Iron Flesh
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and Resistance: Blast.

name: Engine of Destruction
description: The spellcaster gains +2 SPD and +4 MAT and +4 to its melee damage rolls for one turn.

name: Redline
description: Target warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 SPD and can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus. Additionally, the affected model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and collateral damage rolls. At the end of each of its activations, the affected warjack suffers d3 damage points.

name: Road to War
description: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster’s control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range can advance up to 3". A model can advance as a result of Road to War only once per turn.

name: Sentry
description: Target friendly Faction model gains Rapid Fire. (A model with Rapid Fire can make one basic ranged attack during your Maintenance Phase.)

name: Battering Ram
description: An enemy model hit by Battering Ram can be pushed 3" directly away from the spell’s point of origin.

name: Razor Wall
description: Place a wall template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range where it does not touch a model’s base, an obstruction, or an obstacle. When a model enters or ends its activation in the wall template, it suffers 1 damage point.

name: Unstoppable Force
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Bulldoze. Unstoppable Force lasts for one turn. (When a model with Bulldoze is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when a model makes a trample power attack.)

name: Far Strike
description: The spellcaster’s ranged weapons gain Snipe. Far Strike lasts for one turn. (An attack with a weapon with Snipe gains +3 RNG.)

name: Earth Spikes
description: When making this attack, ignore cover and concealment. On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

name: Rapid Growth
description: Place a 3" diameter template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is forest terrain that remains in play as long as its upkeep is paid.

name: Solid Ground
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models cannot become knocked down or be pushed and gain Resistance: Blast.

name: Stone Skin
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 melee attack damage rolls and +2 ARM but suffers –1 SPD and DEF.

name: Crevasse
description: If Crevasse boxes its original target, you can make a SP 6 attack using the boxed model as the attack’s point of origin. Models hit suffer a POW 12 magical damage roll. Models boxed by Crevasse are removed from play.

name: Ground Zero
description: Other models within 3" of the spellcaster suffer a POW 13 blast damage roll. Immediately after this damage is resolved each enemy model damaged by Ground Zero is pushed d6" directly away from the spellcaster in the order you choose.

name: Rock Wall
description: Place a wall template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range where it does not touch a model’s base, an obstruction, or an obstacle. The wall is an obstacle that provides cover. The wall is removed from the table if it is contacted by a model with an extra-large or huge base.

name: Roots of the Earth
description: Target friendly Faction model gains +3 ARM, cannot become knocked down, and cannot move or be placed. Roots of the Earth lasts for one round.

name: Ghost Walk
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Ghostly for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

name: Parasite
description: Target model/unit suffers -3 ARM and the spellcaster gains +1 ARM.

name: Vanish
description: Place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Vanish can be cast only once per activation.

name: Well of Hate
description: Models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gain Murderous while in its control range. Well of Hate lasts for one turn. (A model with Murderous gains an additional die on melee attack rolls against warrior models.)

name: Rage
description: Target friendly Faction warbeast gains +2 to its melee damage rolls.

name: Whispering Veil
description: The spellcaster gains Telemetry. Whispering Veil lasts for one turn. (Other friendly Faction models gain +2 to arcane attack rolls against enemy models within 8" of a model with Telemetry.)

name: Spiny Growth
description: The spellcaster gains +2 ARM. If a non-warrior model hits the spellcaster with a melee attack, the attacking model suffers d3 damage points immediately after the attack is resolved unless the spellcaster was destroyed or removed from play by the attack. Spiny Growth lasts for one round.

name: Submerge
description: The spellcaster cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks and does not block LOS. Submerge lasts for one round.

name: Elasticity
description: Target friendly Faction model’s melee weapons become RNG 2. Elasticity lasts for one turn.

name: Floodwaters
description: While within 5" of the spellcaster, models treat open terrain as shallow water.

name: Hunter’s Mark
description: Friendly models can charge or make a slam power attack against target enemy model hit by Hunter’s Mark without being forced or spending focus. A friendly model charging or power attack slamming an enemy model hit by Hunter’s Mark gains +2 SPD while resolving the charge or slam. Hunter’s Mark lasts for one turn.

name: Blackest Night
description: While within 10" of the spellcaster, enemy models suffer –1 to their attack rolls. Blackest Night lasts for one round.

name: Lurker
description: The spellcaster gains Pathfinder and Bushwhack. Lurker lasts for one turn. (During its activation, a model with Bushwhack can make its Combat Action before its Normal Movement. If it does, it must make a full advance as its Normal Movement that activation.)

name: Force Aura
description: While within 3" of the spellcaster, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and ARM against ranged attacks. Force Aura lasts for one round.

name: Primal
description: Target friendly living Faction warbeast gains +2 MAT and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one round and automatically frenzies during your next Control Phase. The target warbeast frenzies even if Primal was removed by a spell, special rule, or casting of a new animus on it prior to your next Control Phase.

name: Mortality
description: Target model/unit suffers –2 DEF and ARM, loses Tough, and cannot have damage removed from it. Mortality lasts for one round.

name: Pursuit
description: If target enemy model/unit advances during its activation, one model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range can immediately make a full advance.

name: Silence of Death
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and Take Down. Models disabled by a melee attack made by a model with Take Down cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by a melee attack made by a model with Take Down are removed from play.)

name: Elusive
description: The spellcaster gains Dodge. Elusive lasts for one round. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

name: Massacre
description: The spellcaster gains Overtake. Massacre lasts for one turn. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: Despoiler
description: Center a cloud effect template on the spellcaster. The template remains centered on the spellcaster for one round. If the spellcaster is destroyed or removed from play, remove the template from play. Enemy models entering or ending their activations in the template suffer 1 point of corrosion damage.

name: Winter Coat
description: The spellcaster gains Resistance: Cold and Freezer. Winter Coat lasts for one round. (When an enemy model without Resistance: Cold ends its activation within 2" of a model with Freezer, the enemy model becomes stationary for one round.)

name: Breath of Corruption
description: This attack causes corrosion damage. On a hit, center a cloud effect on the model targeted. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model without Resistance: Corrosion entering or ending its activation in the AOE suffers 1 point of corrosion damage.

name: Blood Thorn
description: Target friendly Faction model’s/unit’s ranged and melee weapons gain Continuous Effect: Corrosion.

name: Dragon’s Blood
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM. When an affected model is disabled by a melee attack, the attacker suffers the Corrosion continuous effect.

name: Venom
description: Venom causes corrosion damage. Models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

name: Invocation of Blood
description: If Bethayne is flesh melded with Belphagor when this spell is cast, Belphagor gains +2 SPD, DEF, and ARM  and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one round. Otherwise, Bethayne immediately makes a full advance toward Belphagor. Invocation of Blood can be cast only once per activation.

name: Wraithbane
description: Target friendly Faction model’s weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical. Wraithbane lasts for one turn.

name: Ornery
description: The spellcaster gains Retaliatory Strike. Ornery lasts for one round. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model with Retaliatory Strike can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

name: Slaughterhouse
description: The spellcaster’s melee weapons gain Grievous Wounds. Slaughterhouse lasts for one turn. (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

name: Slipstream
description: When the spellcaster ends its Normal Movement, choose one other large or smaller-based friendly Faction model within 2" of the spellcaster. You can place the chosen model completely within 2" of its current location, then Slipstream expires. A model can be placed as a result of Slipstream only once per turn. Slipstream lasts for one turn.

name: Excessive Healing
description: The spellcaster gains Rapid Healing for one round. (When a model with Rapid Healing is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved remove d3 damage points from it.)

name: Boiling Blood
description: The spellcaster gains Resistance: Fire. Additionally, when the spellcaster suffers damage as a result of an enemy melee attack, after the attack is resolved the attacking model suffers an unboostable POW 14 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect. Boiling Blood lasts for one round.

name: Hornet’s Nest
description: When target friendly Faction lesser warbeast destroys an enemy model with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 1" and make an additional melee attack. Hornet’s Nest lasts for one turn.

name: Death March
description: Target friendly Faction unit gains +2 MAT and Vengeance. (During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in a unit with Vengeance were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.")

name: Flesh Eater
description: When a living enemy model is damaged by Flesh Eater, the spellcaster or a living warbeast in its battlegroup and in its control range can remove d3 damage points.

name: Tide Pool
description: Place a 3" template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is shallow water terrain that remains in play for one round. While in the template models gain Resistance: Fire.

name: Warpath
description: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster’s control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range can advance up to 3". A Cohort model can advance as a result of Warpath only once per turn.

name: Befuddle
description: On a hit, you can immediately take control and advance target  enemy non-Leader model up to 3" then Befuddle expires. A model can move only once per turn as a result of Befuddle.

name: Murder of Crows
description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. An enemy model that enters or ends its activation in the AOE suffers an unboostable POW 8 damage roll.

name: Incite
description: Friendly Faction models gain +2 to attack and damage rolls against enemy models while the enemy models are within 10" of the spellcaster. Incite lasts for one turn.

name: Arcane Ward
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 DEF and cannot be targeted by enemy spells.

name: Mosh Pit
description: Knocked down friendly Faction models in the spellcaster’s control range immediately stand up. While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models' melee weapons gain Knockdown. Mosh Pit lasts for one turn. (When a model is hit with an attack by a weapon with Knockdown, it becomes knocked down.)

name: Wind Wall
description: The spellcaster cannot make ranged attacks after casting this spell, and non-magical ranged attacks targeting it automatically miss. While within 3" of the spellcaster, models cannot make ranged attacks and non-magical ranged attacks targeting them automatically miss. Wind Wall lasts for one round.

name: Frostbite
description: Frostbite causes cold damage. On a critical hit, the model hit becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

name: Snow Shroud
description: Friendly Faction models gain concealment while in the spellcaster’s control range. Snow Shroud lasts for one round.

name: Mystic Wards
description: Enemy animi and enemy upkeep spells on models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that are in its control range immediately expire. Enemy arcane attacks targeting a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup suffer –5 RNG. Mystic Wards lasts for one round.

name: Rift
description: Center a 3" template on the model directly hit. The template is rough terrain and remains in play for one round.

name: Synergy
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in this model’s battlegroup gain a +1 cumulative bonus on melee attack and melee damage rolls for each other model in the battlegroup that hit an enemy model with a melee attack this turn while in the spellcaster’s control range. This cumulative bonus cannot exceed +3.

name: Earth’s Blessing
description: The spellcaster cannot be pushed, knocked down, made stationary, or moved by a slam. Earth’s Blessing lasts for one round.

name: Watery Grave
description: When a model is boxed by Watery Grave, center a 3" template on the boxed model and then remove that model from play. The template is shallow water terrain that remains in play for one round. While in the template models gain Resistance: Fire.

name: Tantrum
description: If one or more models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup were damaged by enemy attacks while within 5" of the spellcaster during your opponent’s last turn, during your Maintenance Phase one model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup in its control range can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

name: Ravager
description: Target cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains Berserk. While affected by Ravager, a model cannot make Chain Attacks. (When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.)

name: Star-Crossed
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, enemy models gain an additional die on attack rolls. Discard the highest die of each roll. Star-Crossed lasts for one round.

name: Arcane Protections
description: While within 10" of the spellcaster, enemy models cannot channel spells. Arcane Protections lasts for one round.

name: Explosivo
description: Target friendly Faction model’s ranged weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. If the affected model directly hits and boxes an enemy model with an attack from a ranged weapon, models within 2" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 8 magical blast damage roll, then the boxed model is removed from play.

name: High Ground
description: Place a 3" template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template remains in play as long as its upkeep is paid. While completely within the template, models gain +2 DEF against ranged and arcane attacks and their ranged weapons gain Arcing Fire. (When attacking with a weapon with Arcing Fire, a model can ignore intervening models.)

name: Open Fire
description: Target Cohort model in this model’s battlegroup that is in its control range can immediately make one basic ranged attack. A model can be targeted by Open Fire only once per turn.

name: Pig Farm
description: The spellcaster gains an additional die on melee damage rolls against living models and Snacking. Pig Farm lasts for one turn. (When a model with Snacking boxes a living model with a melee attack, the model with Snacking can choose to remove the boxed model from play. When it does, this model can remove d3 damage points.)

name: Stonehold
description: Enemy models roll one less die on attack damage rolls against the spellcaster. The spellcaster and friendly Faction models B2B with it cannot become knocked down.

name: Bear Hands
description: When the spellcaster hits an enemy model with a basic melee attack, it can choose to knock down the enemy model or push it 3" directly away. Bear Hands lasts for one turn.

name: Carnivore
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to melee attack rolls. When an affected model destroys a living or undead model with a melee attack, the destroyed model is removed from play and the spellcaster can remove d3 damage points.

name: Death Rattle
description: When Death Rattle boxes a living or undead non-Leader enemy warrior model, you can immediately take control of the model. The boxed model immediately makes one basic attack, then it is removed from play.

name: Force Strike
description: On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down.

name: Soothing Song
description: Remove up to 1 fury point from each friendly living Faction warbeast currently in the spellcaster’s control range. Soothing Song can be cast only once per activation.

name: Manifest Destiny
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll. Manifest Destiny lasts for one turn.

name: Stranglehold
description: A model damaged by Stranglehold forfeits either its Normal Movement or its Combat Action during its next activation, as its controller chooses.

name: White Squall
description: Instead of suffering a normal damage roll, a non-incorporeal model hit by White Squall is thrown d6" directly away from the spell’s point of origin and suffers a POW 12 damage roll. Collateral damage from this throw is POW 12.

name: Lightning Storm
description: On a direct hit, center a cloud effect template on the model hit. The cloud is a hazard that remains in play for one round. Models entering or ending their activations in the template suffer a POW 10 electrical damage roll.

name: Positive Charge
description: Target friendly Faction Cohort model gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls. While within 3" of the affected Cohort model, other friendly Faction models gain +2 on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Positive Charge lasts for one turn.

name: Sidekick
description: Target warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down or be pushed, placed, or moved by a slam. While B2B with target model, the spellcaster gains +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down or be pushed, placed, or moved by a slam.

name: Fire For Effect
description: Boost the attack and damage rolls of target friendly Faction model’s first ranged attack each activation.

name: Vanish
description: Place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Vanish can be cast only once per activation.

name: Banishing Ward
description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on target friendly model/unit expire. Affected models cannot be targeted by enemy spells or animi.

name: Blinding Light
description: A model/unit hit by this spell cannot make ranged or arcane attacks and suffers –2 DEF for one round.

name: Broadside
description: Models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range can immediately make one basic ranged attack. Broadside can be cast only once per activation.

name: Hot-Shot
description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains boosted ranged attack damage rolls.

name: Powder Keg
description: On a critical hit, the model directly hit loses its initial attacks and cannot make power attacks or special attacks for one round.

name: Veil of Mists
description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template does not block friendly Faction models’ LOS. While in the template, friendly Faction models gain Pathfinder and can move through obstructions and other models if they have enough movement to move completely past them.

name: Earth’s Sanctuary
description: Target friendly Faction model becomes dug in. (While dug in, a model gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.)

name: Inhospitable Ground
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, enemy models treat open terrain as rough terrain. Inhospitable Ground lasts for one round.

name: Shadow Step
description: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster suffer Shadow Bind for one round. Additionally, you can place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Shadow Step can be cast only once per activation. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.).

name: Second Sight
description: Target friendly model gains Eyeless Sight.

name: Arcane Charge
description: On a direct hit, models hit suffer –2 ARM for one turn.

name: Deadeye
description: Target friendly Faction model gains an additional die on its next ranged attack roll this turn.

name: Sure Foot
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down.

name: Full Throttle
description: Warjacks in the spellcaster’s battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus that activation. While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain boosted melee attack rolls. Full Throttle lasts for one turn.

name: Jumpstart
description: Shakeable effects on models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that are currently in its control range expire. Models that suffered shakeable effects this turn are not affected by Jumpstart.

name: Black Spot
description: Target enemy warrior model/unit suffers –2 DEF. When a friendly Faction model destroys one or more affected models with a basic melee or ranged attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one additional melee or ranged attack. Attacks gained from Black Spot cannot generate additional attacks from Black Spot.

name: Shellfish Bullets
description: The next enemy model to be hit by a ranged attack made by this model cannot secure Objectives, Scenario terrain, or Caches for one round.

name: High Noon
description: Target friendly Faction model / unit gain +2 DEF and Dodge. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

name: Guided Fire
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain boosted ranged attack rolls for one turn.

name: Pin Cushion
description: Friendly Faction models gain an additional die on ranged attack and ranged damage rolls against target model/unit. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

name: Twister
description: Center a cloud effect template on the model directly hit. The template remains in play for one round.

name: Rhythm of War
description: Warjacks in this model's battlegroup that are in its control range can advance up to 3" after all friendly models have ended their activations on your turn.

name: Countermeasure
description: While within 5" of target friendly Faction model/unit, enemy models cannot make ranged attacks.

name: Blow the Man Down
description: A model hit by Blow the Man Down becomes knocked down. On a critical hit, instead of suffering a normal damage roll a non-incorporeal model hit is slammed d6" directly away from the spell’s point of origin and suffers a POW 14 damage roll. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 14.

name: Coup de Main
description: The spellcaster and friendly Privateer models activating in its control range gain +2 SPD when advancing as part of their Normal Movement. Affected warjacks can charge without spending a focus point. Coup de Main lasts for one turn.

name: Veil of Darkness
description: When target friendly Faction model/unit is targeted by a ranged attack, the attack suffers –5 RNG.

name: Windstorm
description: The spellcaster gains Warping Winds. Windstorm lasts for one round. (When a friendly Faction model is targeted by a ranged attack while within 3" of this model, the attack suffers -3 RNG. Additionally, while within 3" of this model, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast.)

name: Fog of War
description: Models gain concealment while in the spellcaster’s control range.

name: Crimson Ballet
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Sprint. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

name: Shadow Pack
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Stealth. Shadow Pack lasts for one round.

name: Arcane Shield
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +3 ARM.

name: Electro Bolt
description: Electro Bolt causes electrical damage.

name: Scramble
description: Target warjack suffers Disruption for one round.

name: Time Lock
description: Enemy models activating within 6" of the spellcaster suffer –2 SPD that activation. Time Lock lasts for one round.

name: Abattoir
description: Models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range can immediately make one basic melee attack. Abattoir can be cast only once per turn.

name: Castigate
description: Enemy models cannot be used to channel spells or be forced to cast an animus while in the spellcaster’s control range. Castigate lasts for one round.

name: Eliminator
description: Immediately after this attack is resolved, the spellcaster can advance up to 2" for each enemy model destroyed by the attack.

name: Chasten
description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on target model/unit damaged by this attack expire.

name: Battle Lust
description: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains an additional die on melee damage rolls but suffers –2 DEF.

name: Arcane Blast
description: On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

name: Safeguard
description: The spellcaster cannot become knocked down or stationary and does not suffer collateral damage. When it is slammed, reduce the slam distance rolled by 3. Safeguard lasts for one round.

name: Prescience
description: Target friendly Faction model gains Future Sight. Prescience lasts for one turn.

name: Spirit Blade
description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on target friendly Faction model/unit expire.

name: Haunting Melody
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, living enemy models cannot make melee or ranged attacks targeting a model in spellcaster's battlegroup.

name: Weald Secrets
description: Target model/unit gains Pathfinder and Prowl. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

name: Annihilation
description: Models destroyed by Annihilation are removed from play and do not generate corpse tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed by Annihilation, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

name: Soul Shift
description: Remove a friendly Faction warrior model within 4" of the spellcaster from play and replace it with a friendly Faction cohort model within 4" of the spellcaster. The cohort model must forfeit its Normal Movement and cannot attack after being placed by Soul Shift this turn. Soul Shift can only be cast once per turn.

name: Ferocious Impact
description: Target friendly Faction model gains +2 to its next ranged attack damage roll.

name: Grave Wind
description: Target friendly Faction model gains +2 DEF and Poltergeist. (When an enemy model misses a model with Poltergeist with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to push the enemy model d3" directly away from the model with Poltergeist.)

name: Sand Storm
description: When a friendly model is targeted by a ranged attack while within 5" of this model, the attack suffers –3 RNG. Sand Storm lasts for one round.

name: Arcane Suppression
description: While within 10" of the spellcaster, when an enemy model casts a spell, increase the COST of the spell by 1. Additionally, while within 10" of the spellcaster, enemy models must pay double to upkeep spells. Arcane Suppression lasts for one round.

name: Irresistible Force
description: The spellcaster gains Bulldoze. Irresistible Force lasts for one turn. (When a model with Bulldoze is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when a model makes a trample power attack.)

name: Cold Front
description: The spellcaster gains Chiller for one turn. (While within 2" of a model with Chiller, enemy models without Resistance: Cold suffer –2 DEF.)

name: Carrion Feast
description: Center a cloud effect template on the model directly hit. The template is a hazard and remains in play as long as upkeep is paid. While in the template, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.

name: Mirage
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Apparition. (During your Control Phase, place models with Apparition anywhere completely within 2" of their current locations.)

name: Night’s Reflection
description: Target model/unit suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or magic attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

name: Blood Mark
description: Target enemy model suffers –2 ARM. The spellcaster can transfer damage from an enemy attack to the affected model one time, then Blood Mark expires.

name: Influence
description: Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model. The model immediately makes one basic attack, then Influence expires. A model can be affected by Influence only once per turn.

name: Sunder Spirit
description: An enemy warbeast damaged by Sunder Spirit loses its animus for one round.

name: Lucky Shot
description: Target friendly Faction model can reroll its next missed ranged attack roll this turn. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Lucky Shot. Lucky shot lasts for one turn.

name: Aggravator
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction warbeasts gain Hyper-Aggressive. (When a model with Hyper-Aggressive suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.)

name: Crippling Grasp
description: Target model/unit suffers –2 SPD, DEF, and ARM. Additionally, an affected model suffers –2 to its melee attack damage rolls.

name: Forced Evolution
description: Target friendly living Faction warbeast gains +2 DEF and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls

name: Killing Ground
description: Friendly Faction models beginning a charge in the spellcaster’s control range gain Pathfinder. Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range can charge or make slam power attacks against enemy models without being forced. Killing Ground lasts for one turn.

name: Primed
description: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls. If an affected model is disabled by an enemy attack, models within 1" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 blast damage roll and the affected model is removed from play.

name: Marked for Death
description: Target model/unit suffers –2 DEF, loses Incorporeal and Stealth and cannot gain Incorporeal or Stealth while affected by Marked for Death.

name: Magic Bullet
description: If target friendly Faction model’s next basic ranged attack directly hits, after resolving the attack choose another model within 4" of the model hit. The chosen model suffers an unboostable POW 12 magical damage roll. The point of origin for this damage is the model hit. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. After resolving this damage roll, Magic Bullet expires. Magic Bullet lasts for one turn.

name: Forced Induction
description: On a direct hit, target enemy Cohort gains 1 focus, fury or essence point. Then the target Cohort model and each enemy model within 1" for each focus, fury or essence point on it suffer an unboostable POW 10 electrical damage roll.

name: Spellpiercer
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, the weapons of friendly Faction models gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical. Spellpiercer lasts for one turn.

name: Dash
description: The spellcaster and friendly Faction warrior models activating in its control range gain +1 SPD. Dash lasts for one turn.

name: Dissolution Bolt
description: A model hit by Dissolution Bolt cannot channel spells for one round.

name: Discontinuity
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, the melee weapons of models in its battlegroup gain Dispel. (When a weapon with Dispel hits a model/unit, upkeep spells and animi on that model/unit immediately expire.)

name: Descending Gloom
description: Target model hit suffers Blind. Centre a cloud effect template on the model hit. Enemy models entering or ending their activations in the template suffer Blind. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or magic attacks, suffers -4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

name: Eye of Dhunia
description: While attacking target model/unit, friendly Faction models gain Eyeless Sight and their weapons gain Magical and Blessed.

name: Brand of Fire
description: Brand of Fire causes fire damage. On a hit, the target model and the d3 nearest enemy models within 3" of it suffer the Fire continuous effect.

name: Firestarter
description: Target a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup. That model’s melee and ranged weapons gain Continuous Effect: Fire.

name: Fire Step
description: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster suffer a POW 13 fire damage roll . After the damage is resolved, place the spellcaster completely within 2" of its current location. Fire Step can be cast only once per activation.

name: Hex Hammer
description: When an enemy model declares it is casting a spell while in this model’s control range, the enemy spellcaster immediately suffers d3 damage points. If the enemy spellcaster is destroyed as a result of this damage, the spell does not take effect. Hex Hammer lasts for one round.

name: Immolation
description: Immolation causes fire damage. On a critical hit, the model hit suffers the Fire continuous effect.

name: Rush
description: Target friendly Faction warbeast gains +2 SPD and gains Pathfinder. Rush lasts for one turn.

name: Roth’s Mercy
description: When an enemy attack disables a living model in the target friendly Faction unit, you can choose a non-disabled living model in the unit to be destroyed. If another model is destroyed as a result of Roth’s Mercy, the disabled model removes 1 damage point.

name: Soulfire
description: When a living, non-soulless enemy model is boxed by Soulfire, the spellcaster gains 1 focus, fury, or essence point and the boxed model is removed from play. If the spellcaster does not have a special rule that allows it to gain focus, fury, or essence points, it cannot gain a focus, fury, or essence point as a result of Soulfire.

name: Magnetic Hold
description: Target enemy model/unit suffers –2 SPD and DEF and cannot charge or make slam or trample power attacks. Friendly Faction construct models charging an affected model gain +2 SPD.

name: Cyclone
description: The spellcaster immediately makes a full advance. At the end of this movement, the spellcaster can make one basic melee attack against each model in its LOS that is in its melee range. Cyclone can be cast only once per activation.

name: Razor Wind
description: On a critical hit on a warjack or warbeast, fill in the unmarked damage boxes or circles on the last column or branch damaged.

name: Winter’s Wrath
description: Winter’s Wrath causes cold damage. On a critical hit, models hit becomes stationary for one round unless they have Resistance: Cold.

name: Wind Rush
description: The spellcaster can immediately make a full advance and gains +2 DEF for one round. Wind Rush can be cast only once per activation.

name: See in the Dark
description: Taget model gains Eyeless Sight.

name: Electrical Blast
description: Electrical Blast causes electrical damage. Warjacks damaged by Electrical Blast suffer Disruption.

name: Frozen Ground
description: When an enemy model without Resistance: Cold ends its activation within 3" of the spellcaster, the enemy model becomes knocked down. Frozen Ground lasts for one round

name: Soul Gate
description: Remove a friendly trooper model in the spellcaster’s control range from play and replace it with target warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. The warjack cannot activate this turn after being placed by Soul Gate.

name: Lamentation
description: When an enemy model casts a spell while in the spellcaster’s control range, double the COST of the spell. Additionally, enemy models must pay double to upkeep spells on models/units in the spellcaster’s control range.

name: Shadowmancer
description: While in spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Stealth and Dark Shroud. Shadowmancer lasts for one round. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.)

name: Abyssal Gate
description: When Abyssal Gate damages a non-Leader enemy model, after the attack is resolved you can place the enemy model anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. A model can be placed by Abyssal Gate only once per turn.

name: Infernal Machine
description: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains Murderous and +2 SPD. (A model with Murderous gains an additional die on melee attack rolls against warrior models.)

name: Siphon Bolt
description: When this spell hits an enemy model with 1 or more focus or fury points on it, that model loses 1 focus or fury point and the spellcaster gains 1 focus point. Spellcasters without the Focus Manipulation special rule cannot gain focus as a result of Siphon Bolt.

name: Grind
description: When a warjack is hit by Grind, it suffers 1 damage point to its first available Movement system box.

name: Strength of Granite
description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +4 to its melee attack damage rolls.

name: Sacrosanct
description: When an enemy non-Leader warrior model destroys one or more friendly Faction models in the spellcaster’s control range with a melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the attacking model becomes knocked down.

name: Assail
description: Target friendly Faction warjack can charge or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus. The warjack gains +2 SPD when it charges or makes a slam or trample power attack. Models slammed by the warjack are moved +2".

name: Ashes to Ashes
description: If target model is directly hit, the d3 nearest enemy models within 4" of it suffer a POW 10 fire damage roll. These additional damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Resolve damage resulting from Ashes to Ashes simultaneously with the damage resulting from the attack that directly hit.

name: Death Sentence
description: When a friendly Faction model misses target enemy model/unit with an attack, it can reroll the attack roll. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Death Sentence.

name: Defender's Ward
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 DEF and ARM.

name: Crawling Chaos
description: While B2B with the spellcaster, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and cannot advance. Crawling Chaos lasts for one round.

name: Crawling Chaos
description: While B2B with the spellcaster, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and cannot advance. Crawling Chaos lasts for one round.

name: Mantrap
description: On a direct hit, warrior models hit become knocked down.

name: Deflection
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF against ranged and arcane attacks. Deflection lasts for one round.

name: Discord
description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains Wailing. (While within 5" of a model with Wailing, enemy models cannot cast or channel spells.)

name: Wind Burst
description: After resolving this attack, cloud templates in the spellcaster’s control range expire.

name: Call of the Grave
description: Models damaged by Call of the Grave suffer Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

name: Rapport
description: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can use the spellcaster’s current MAT and RAT in place of its own. When checking to see if the affected Cohort model is in its controller’s control range, double the range.

name: Muzzle
description: An enemy warbeast damaged by Muzzle cannot advance toward the spellcaster for one round.

name: Creator’s Wrath
description: The spellcaster gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls and its melee weapons gains Blessed.

name: Brand of Heresy
description: Cohort models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gain boosted attack and damage rolls against target model/unit.

name: Inviolable Resolve
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down or moved by a push or a slam.

name: Unminding
description: Target enemy warbeast suffers –2 FURY and THR and loses its animus. The spellcaster can cast an affected warbeast’s animus.

name: Rampager
description: Take control of target enemy warbeast. You can make one full advance with the warbeast and can then make one basic attack, then Rampager expires. While the warbeast is affected by Rampager, it cannot be forced and you cannot use its animus. Rampager can be cast only once per activation. A warbeast can be affected by Rampager only once per turn.

name: Spiritual Conduit
description: This model’s controller can channel spells through it. Spiritual Conduit lasts for one turn.

name: Flaming Fists
description: The spellcaster gains +2 to melee damage rolls and Resistance: Fire, and its melee weapons gain Continuous Effect: Fire. Flaming Fists lasts for one round.

name: Lightning Fists
description: The spellcaster gains Resistance: Electricity and its melee weapons gain Electro Leap. Lightning Fists lasts for one round. (When a model is directly hit with a basic attack made with a weapon with Electro Leap, you can have lightning arc to the nearest model within 3" of the model hit, ignoring the attacking model. The model the lightning arcs to suffers an unboostable POW 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Resolve lightning arc damage rolls simultaneously with the damage resulting from the attack that caused the leap.)

name: Thunder Strike
description: Instead of suffering a normal damage roll, a non-incorporeal model hit by Thunder Strike is slammed d6" directly away from the spell’s point of origin and suffers a POW 14 damage roll. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 14.

name: Ravening Hunger
description: The spellcaster gains Snacking. (When a model with snacking boxes a living model with a melee attack, it can choose to remove the boxed model from play. When it does, this model can remove d3 damage points.)

name: Feedback Loop
description: When target enemy Cohort model that is part of a battlegroup is damaged, its controller suffers 1 damage point.

name: Shrapnel Swarm
description: On a direct hit, after resolving the damage roll, the model hit and models within 1" suffer 1 damage point.

name: Tactical Supremacy
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Reposition [3"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Velocity
description: The spellcaster can spend up to 3 focus points to immediately advance up to 2" for each focus point spent. Velocity can be cast only once per activation.

name: Signs & Portents
description: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll. Signs & Portents lasts for one turn.

name: Feint
description: The spellcaster gains Reposition [3"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Backlash
description: When target enemy warjack that is part of a battlegroup is damaged, its controller suffers 1 damage point.

name: Phantom Hunter
description: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup ignores LOS when making charges and attacks. That model ignores concealment, cover, and Stealth when resolving attacks. Phantom Hunter lasts for one turn.

name: Dark Guidance
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on their melee attack rolls this turn.

name: Eruption
description: This attack causes fire damage. On a hit, center a cloud effect on the model targeted. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model without Resistance: Fire entering or ending its activation in the AOE suffer the Fire continuous effect.

name: Invocations of Wrath
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll. Invocations of Wrath lasts for one turn.

name: Tempest
description: On a direct hit, models hit become knocked down.

name: Dark Unraveling
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, the weapons of models in its battlegroup gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical. Dark Unraveling lasts for one turn.

name: Spirit Fang
description: A model damaged by this attack suffers –2 SPD and DEF for one round.

name: Superiority
description: Target friendly Faction warjack gains +2 SPD, MAT, and DEF and cannot become knocked down.

name: Dog Pile
description: Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can charge or make slam power attacks against target model without being forced. Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can ignore forests and cloud effects when determining LOS when declaring a charge or slam attack against the affected model. Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gain +2 SPD and Pathfinder when resolving charges or slam power attacks targeting the affected model.

name: Spirit Shift
description: When Laris casts Spirit Shift, immediately place him completely within 2" of Kaya. When Kaya casts Spirit Shift, immediately place her completely within 2" of Laris. A model cannot advance this turn after being placed by Spirit Shift.

name: Blood Spiller
description: Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can charge or make a slam power attack against target enemy model hit by Blood Spiller without being forced for one turn.

name: Freezing Mist
description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. While in the template, living enemy models without Resistance: Cold suffer –2 to attack rolls.

name: Watcher
description: Once per turn when an enemy model advances and ends its movement within 6" of the spellcaster, you can choose a Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. That Cohort model can immediately make a full advance toward the enemy model and then can make one basic attack targeting the enemy model.

name: Cursed Fate
description: Target model/unit suffers –2 DEF. When a damage roll resulting from a direct hit fails to exceed the ARM of an affected model, the model suffers 1 damage point. Cursed Fate lasts for one turn.

name: Hoarfrost
description: Hoarfrost causes cold damage. On a critical hit, the model hit becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

name: Airburst
description: Target any model in the spellcaster’s control range, ignoring LOS. When resolving Airburst, ignore cover, concealment, and Stealth.

name: Freezing Grip
description: Target model/unit without Resistance: Cold becomes stationary for one round.

name: Dauntless Resolve
description: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +3 ARM and Tough.

name: Tides of War
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. Tides of War lasts for one turn. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Bestial
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, enemy models cannot cast non-animus spells or be used to channel spells. Bestial lasts for one round.

name: Vengeful
description: Target friendly Faction model gains Retaliatory Strike. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model with Retaliatory Strike can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

name: Fleeting Storm
description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. Ranged attacks targetting a model completely within the template suffer –3 RNG. The AOE remains in play for one round.

name: Lightning Tendrils
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Resistance: Electricity. Affected models’ melee weapons become RNG 2 and gain Electro Leap.

name: Spontaneous Combustion
description: The spellcaster and models within 2" of it immediately suffer the Fire continuous effect.

name: Druid's Wrath
description: Friendly Faction models gain an additional die on arcane attack rolls targeting enemy models within 10" of the spellcaster. Druid’s Wrath lasts for one turn.

name: Lightning Tendrils
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Resistance: Electricity. Affected models’ melee weapons become RNG 2 and gain Electro Leap.

name: Skyborne
description: The spellcaster gains +2 SPD and DEF and Flight for one round.

name: Howling Flames
description: Howling Flames causes fire damage. Models hit by this attack suffer the Fire continuous effect.

name: Vortex of Destruction
description: Damage rolls against enemy models in the spellcaster’s melee range are automatically boosted.

name: Heart of Ice
description: Target friendly Faction non-construct model/unit gains +2 ARM and Resistance: Cold. When an affected model is destroyed or removed from play by a melee attack made by an enemy warrior model, at the end of its activation the attacking model becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

name: Snowsquall
description: Enemy models activating in this model’s control range lose Eyeless Sight, Flight, and Pathfinder for one turn.

name: Snow-Wreathed
description: The spellcaster has concealment. Snow-Wreathed lasts for one round.

name: Excarnate
description: When a living enemy warrior model is boxed by Excarnate, remove it from play. You can then add one Grunt to a friendly Faction small-based undead unit in the spellcaster’s control range. Place the Grunt within 1" of another model in the unit. The Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

name: Hellbound
description: The spellcaster cannot be targeted by charges or slam power attacks. While within 5" of the spellcaster, enemy models treat open ground as rough terrain. Hellbound lasts for one round.

name: Malediction
description: While within 2" of the spellcaster, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and ARM.

name: Dark Fire
description: When a living enemy model is destroyed by Dark Fire, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

name: Lifebound
description: Target friendly living model/unit gains Shield Guard. When an affected model is destroyed by an enemy attack, the spellcaster gains its soul token. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

name: Foresight
description: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup can reroll missed attack rolls. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Foresight.

name: Flesh Hooks
description: Target living or undead model damaged by Flesh Hooks cannot charge or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.

name: Shadow Play
description: Target friendly Faction model gains Incorporeal this turn. During your Control Phase, the affected model gains Incorporeal for one turn.

name: Feast of Worms
description: Center a cloud template on the model directly hit. The template is a hazard and remains in play as long as upkeep is paid. While in the template, enemy models suffer –2 ARM. When a living enemy model is destroyed in the template, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.
