name: Soul Slave
description: Target warbeast in the spellcaster’s battlegroup automatically passes threshold checks. The spellcaster can channel spells through that warbeast.

name: Eruption of Spines
description: If target model is hit, the d3 nearest models within 5" of it suffer a POW 10 damage roll. These additional damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Eruption of Spines damage rolls are simultaneous.

name: Putrid Miasma
description: While within 6" of this model, friendly models gain Magic Resistance. (When a model with Magic Resistance is targeted by an arcane attack roll, the attacking model rolls 1 additional die on its attack roll. Discard the highest die of each roll.) Putrid Miasma lasts for one round.

name: Vortex of the Deep
description: Place a 3" template anywhere completely within 10" of the spellcaster. The template is shallow water terrain that remains in play for one round. While in the template models gain Resistance: Fire.

name: Even Ground
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down. Even Ground lasts for one round.

name: Death Pact
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models gain +2 ARM and Undead. Death Pact lasts for one round.

name: Soul Void
description: When target friendly Faction model/unit destroys a living enemy model with a melee attack, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

name: Morale Boost
description: When an enemy model is destroyed in the spellcaster's control range, the spellcaster can gain one fury point. The spellcaster's fury point total cannot exceed its ARC as a result of Morale Boost.

name: Arcane Propulsion
description: Target cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 SPD, +2 DEF, and Flight.

name: Firepower
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its ranged attack damage rolls.

name: Heightened Reflexes
description: Target friendly model can not be knocked down or made stationary for one round.

name: Lightning Pulse
description: A model hit by Lightning Pulse suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll, and lightning arcs to the nearest model within 3" of the model hit, ignoring the attacking model. The model the lightning arcs to suffers an unboostable POW 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Lightning Pulse damage rolls are simultaneous with the damage from the attack that caused the leap.

name: Domination
description: Take control of target enemy warjack that has a non-crippled cortex. You can make a full advance with the warjack and can then make one basic attack, then Domination expires. Domination can be cast only once per activation. A warjack can be affected by Domination only once per turn.

name: Temporal Distortion
description: This model gains +2 DEF. While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and enemy models suffer –2 DEF. Temporal Distortion lasts for one round.

name: Time Bomb
description: A model directly hit by Time Bomb suffers –2 SPD and DEF for one round.

name: Fate Walker
description: The spellcaster gains Reposition [5"] this activation. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [5"] can advance up to 5", then its activation ends.)

name: Breath Stealer
description: Target model/unit suffers –2 SPD and DEF for one round.

name: Gravetouched
description: While within 2" of target friendly Faction model, enemy models suffer –2 DEF.

name: Death's Dominion
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Undead models gain Resistance: Blast and Rise. (If a model with RIse is knocked down at the beginning of your Maintenance Phase, it stands up.)

name: Doom Spiral
description: When Doom Spiral damages a warjack that is part of a battlegroup, its controller suffers d3 damage points.

name: Overrun
description: When target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup destroys one or more enemy models with an attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved one other model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range can make a full advance, then Overrun expires. A model can advance only once per turn as a result of Overrun. Overrun lasts for one turn.

name: Sacrificial Lamb
description: Remove one friendly Faction warrior model in the spellcaster’s control range from play. Each warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is currently in its control range gains 1 focus point. Sacrificial Lamb can be cast only once per activation.

name: Spectral Steel
description: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 ARM and Ghostly. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

name: Abuse
description: Target friendly Faction warbeast gains +2 SPD and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one turn but suffers d3 damage points.

name: Undergrowth
description: While within 5" of the spellcaster, enemy models treat open terrain as rough terrain and suffer –2 DEF. Undergrowth lasts for one round.

name: Full Steam
description: Target friendly Faction warbeast can charge without being forced. When the affected model charges a construct model, it gains +2 SPD.

name: Chameleon
description: The spellcaster gains Pathfinder and Adaptive. (While a model with Adaptive is completely within a terrain feature that provides concealment or cover, it gains +1 DEF.)

name: Fog Wall
description: While within 3" of the spellcaster, friendly models gain concealment.

name: Rage Fuel
description: The spellcaster gains Primal Rage. Rage Fuel lasts for one round. (Once per turn, when a model with Primal Rage suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance toward the attacking model and can make one basic melee attack.)

name: Pillar of Salt
description: Place a 3" template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range where it does not overlap a model's base. The template is considered to be a friendly huge-based construct model. The template has DEF 5 and ARM 20, and is removed from play if it suffers 1 or more damage points. The template has no Normal Movement or Combat Action, cannot become knocked down, placed, or be moved, and is automatically hit by melee attacks. The template remains in play for one round.

name: Sands of Fate
description: Remove a friendly living Faction trooper model in the spellcaster’s control range from play and replace it with the spellcaster. The spellcaster cannot advance this activation after being placed by Sands of Fate.

name: Sunhammer
description: Enemy warbeasts and warjacks that advance more than 1" and end their Normal Movement in the spellcaster’s control range suffer d3 damage points.

name: Goad
description: Target Cohort model in this model's battlegroup immediately gains 1 focus point.

name: Eruption of Life
description: If this attack destroys a living or undead enemy model, center a 3" template on the destroyed model, then remove that model from play. The template is forest terrain that remains in play for one round. Enemy models in the template when it is put into play suffer an unboostable POW 13 blast damage roll. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack.

name: Harvest
description: When a living or undead enemy model is destroyed in the spellcaster’s control range, the spellcaster can gain 1 fury point. The spellcaster’s fury point total cannot exceed its ARC as a result of Harvest.

name: Restoration
description: Target friendly Faction unit gains +2 ARM. During your Control Phase, the spellcaster can spend fury points to return one destroyed small- or medium-based living Grunt from that unit to play for each fury point spent. A returned Grunt must be placed in the spellcaster’s control range and within 2" of another model in its unit. The Grunt is returned with one unmarked damage box and must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions this turn.

name: Black Talons
description: On a critical hit, models hit suffer Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

name: Blackest Night
description: While within 10" of the spellcaster, enemy models suffer –1 to their attack rolls. Blackest Night lasts for one round.

name: Thistle
description: If the target model is within 2" of forest terrain, attack and damage rolls are boosted when resolving this spell.

name: Lashing Tendrils
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit's melee weapons become RNG 2 and gain Chain Weapon.

name: Locked Horns
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Unyielding. Locked Horns lasts for one round. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

name: Icy Grip
description: Target model hit without Resistance: Cold suffers –2 SPD for one round.

name: Ritual Sacrifice
description:
Remove target friendly warrior model from play. Skarre gains d6 additional focus points at the start of her next activation. Skarre
can gain the benefit of Ritual Sacrifice only once per round.

name: Scavenger’s Blessing
description: Target model/unit gains Pathfinder and Prowl. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

name: Instability Equation
description: Target friendly warjack stands up and is no longer stationary. If the warjack was suffering Disruption, it is no longer disrupted. The warjack gains up to 3 focus points and gains Unstable for one turn. (At the end of an activation in which a model with Unstable spent more than 1 focus point, roll a d6. If the roll is equal to or less than the number of focus points spent, the model with Unstable explodes and other models within 3" of it suffer an unboostable POW 14 blast damage roll. Remove the model with Unstable from play.)

name: Puissance
description: Target friendly model/unit gains +2 to its melee damage rolls and its melee weapons gain Beat Back. (Immediately after a basic attack with a weapon with Beat Back is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it".)

name: Shockwave
description: On a direct hit, the model hit and other models within 2" of it become knocked down.

name: Amuck
description: When target friendly Faction warbeast makes a power attack or special attack, its attack rolls are boosted. Amuck lasts for one turn.

name: Pigpen
description: While within 3" of the spellcaster, enemy models treat open terrain as rough terrain.

name: Respawn
description: When target large-based or smaller warbeast in the spellcaster’s battlegroup is disabled by an enemy attack place it anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Remove 1 damage point from each aspect, then Respawn expires.

name: Psychic Vampire
description: When an enemy model declares it is casting a spell while in this model's control range, the enemy spellcaster immediately suffers 1 damage point and this model can remove 1 damage point. If the enemy spellcaster is destroyed as a result of this damage, the spell does not take effect.

name: The Flesh Is Weak
description: Living and undead models damaged by The Flesh Is Weak cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.

name: Host of Shadows
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Ghostly. Host of Shadows lasts for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

name: Dark Waves
description: When the spellcaster ends its Normal Movement this activation, choose one other large or smaller-based friendly Faction model within 2" of the spellcaster. You can place the chosen model completely within 2" of its current location, then Dark Waves expires. A model can be placed as a result of Dark Waves only once per turn.

name: Hand of the Creator
description: Remove d3 damage points from each friendly Faction model currently in the spellcaster’s control range. This spell can be cast only once per activation.

name: Sky Fire
description: The spellcaster gains Ionization [10"] for one turn. (When a model without Resistance: Electricity suffers an electrical damage roll while within 10" of a model with Ionization, add +2 to the roll.)

name: Awakened Spirit
description: Target warbeast in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can cast its animus once during its activation without being forced. A warbeast that casts its animus as a result of Awakened Spirit cannot also be forced to cast its animus that activation.

name: Death to Dust
description: A model boxed by this attack is removed from play.

name: Mutagenesis
description: Target enemy model boxed by Mutagenesis is removed from play. When Mutagenesis boxes an enemy model and the spellcaster was the spell’s point of origin, the spellcaster can replace the boxed model when it is removed from play. The spellcaster cannot advance this activation after replacing another model as a result of Mutagenesis. Mutagenesis can be cast only once per activation.

name: Twisted Form
description: Target enemy warbeast suffers –2 FURY, cannot have damage removed from it, and cannot have damage transferred to it. Twisted Form lasts for one round. Twisted Form can be cast only once per activation.

name: Discordance
description: Models in this model’s battlegroup gain Wailing. (While within 5" of a model with Wailing, enemy models cannot cast or channel spells.)

name: Enfeeble
description: Target model/unit suffers –2 to attack and damage rolls.

name: Guided Hand
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains an additional die on each model’s next melee attack roll this turn.

name: Wall of Fire
description: Place the wall template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range where it does not touch a model’s base, an obstruction, or an obstacle. When a model enters or ends its activation in the wall template, it suffers an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect. Models within the wall template gain concealment.

name: Avatar of Slaughter
description: Target the Old Witch or Scrapjack. The affected model gains +2 MAT, +2 to its melee damage rolls, Berserk, and Overtake. (When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.) (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

name: Unseen Path
description: Unseen Path can be cast only while Scrapjack is in the Old Witch’s control range. Immediately place the Old Witch completely within 2" of Scrapjack or place Scrapjack completely within 2" of the Old Witch. A model cannot advance this turn after being placed by Unseen Path.

name: Force Wall
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Force Barrier for one round. (A model with Force Barrier gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls and gains Resistance: Blast.)

name: Arcane Dampening
description: The spellcaster gains Magic Static. Arcane Dampening lasts for one round. (Spells cast by enemy models within 10" of a model with Arcane Dampening model suffer +1 COST and –3 RNG.)

name: First Blood
description: When an enemy model is damaged by First Blood, immediately after the attack is resolved one model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is currently in its control range can make a full advance toward the damaged model. A model can advance as a result of First Blood only once per turn.

name: Kiss of Lyliss
description: When a friendly Faction model makes a damage roll against a model/unit hit by Kiss of Lyliss, add +2 to the roll.

name: Frost Field
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Chiller. (While within 2" of a model with Chiller, enemy models without Resistance: Cold suffer –2 DEF.)

name: Penitence
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit. When one or more affected models are damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the attacker suffers 1 point of fire damage unless it has Immunity: Fire.

name: Martial Paragon
description: The spellcaster gains an additional die on melee attack rolls and Unstoppable.

name: Blood of Kings
description: The spellcaster gains +3 SPD, MAT, DEF, and ARM. Additionally, the spellcaster gains +3 to its melee attack damage rolls. Blood of Kings lasts for one round.

name: Hollow
description: Target friendly Faction unit gains +2 ARM. Once per turn, when an affected model is disabled by an enemy attack, replace it with a friendly Void Spirit model. A model replaced by Hollow is destroyed.

name: Expendable Creation
description: Target non-huge based horror in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 SPD and can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending essence. Additionally, the affected model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and collateral damage rolls. At the end of each of its activations, the affected horror suffers D3 damage points.

name: Easy Rider
description: The spellcaster and friendly Faction models beginning their activations in its control range gain Pathfinder. Easy Rider lasts for one turn.

name: Doppler Bark
description: Living or undead enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster have their base DEF reduced to 5 and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.

name: Damnation
description: Warjacks in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can charge or make slam power attacks against target model without spending focus. They can ignore forests and cloud effects when determining LOS when declaring a charge or slam attack against the affected model. They gain +2" movement and Pathfinder when resolving charges or slam power attacks targeting the affected model.

name: Crimson Veil
description: Target friendly Faction model's melee weapons gain Blood Shadow. (If an attack with a weapon with Blood Shadow boxes a living or undead model, this model can gain Incorporeal for one round.)

name: Dark Path
description: Dark Path can be cast only while Cassius is in Wurmwood’s control range. Immediately place Cassius completely within 2" of Wurmwood or place Wurmwood completely within 2" of Cassius. A model cannot advance this turn after being placed by Dark Path.

name: Rites of Torment
description: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster’s control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one horror in the spellcaster’s battlegroup in its control range can advance up to 3". A horror can advance only once per turn as a result of Rites of Torment.

name: Reconstruct
description: When target large-based or smaller Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup is disabled by an enemy attack place it anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Remove 1 damage point from each system or aspect, then Reconstruct expires.
